methodology.nursing_structural_concept_coverage: Count of NP I-V concept IDs with a published Nursing lesson section of at least 350 non-whitespace body characters and explicit related_concept_ids; a structural measure, not academic sufficiency or approval.
methodology.notes: Notes and generic source lists do not count as concept teaching without a concept-specific substantive section
methodology.question_inventory: active canonical records whose taxonomy board_id is nursing; eligibility is checked separately by production QuestionEligibilityService in focused tests
methodology.exact_links: study-question-links rows carrying lesson_id and section_id, counted only for canonical Nursing board IDs
methodology.shared_science: ten Nursing board coverage rows are reported separately from the 30 NP I-V concepts
methodology.portfolio_section_mappings: B702 reports 1,013 section mapping rows and 55 pending review. Raw storage has 1,013 section_id rows, 31 rows with explicit lesson_id plus section_id, and 55 rows tagged pending independent review. B703 reports these separately and validates new links through production study services.
methodology.sources: Existing registered source associations and scope sources are not treated as concept-level verified teaching unless attached to a substantive mapped section.

summary.global_structural_concept_coverage: 382/646 per B702 final report; denominator/taxonomy unchanged on this baseline
summary.reconciliation_note: 20 published nle-* Nursing curriculum materials are in scope; one shared constitution-review-foundation also lists Nursing eligibility but is not counted as an NP curriculum material. Storage records contain 1,013 rows with section_id; only 31 currently include an explicit lesson_id. These counts are reported separately and new relationships are validated through StudyLibraryService.
summary.source_only_method: Distinct active canonical Nursing question IDs with at least one study-question-link and no row carrying both lesson_id and section_id; source-only link rows retain their source_ids.

impact_ranked_backlog: Safety-critical assessment and escalation: maternal/newborn, oxygenation, fluids, immunity, emergency/shock
Foundational community assessment, prevention-stage distinctions, outbreak proportion reasoning, vulnerability/access barriers
Family partnership, teach-back, developmental trajectory and postpartum observation
Nutrition intake/swallow/culture assessment and acute sensory change
Unmapped Cellular, Labor, Newborn, GI, Endocrine, Coordination, Disaster: seek bounded primary/open educational sources before expansion
